UI_AMS_EnableThermalModel_tooltip: Effective clothing insulation adds endurance burden during sustained body heat. Disable to remove AMS thermal burden.
UI_AMS_EnableMuscleStrainModel_tooltip: Heavy armor increases muscle strain when swinging melee weapons.
UI_AMS_EnableSleepPenaltyModel_tooltip: Sleeping in heavy or rigid armor slows recovery.
UI_AMS_Help_Overview: Overview: The Burden tab shows the physical demand of worn equipment and any additional pressures that are affecting you right now.
UI_AMS_Help_Burden: Burden: The main tier and bar describe the stable weight, bulk, and movement restriction of your worn gear.
UI_AMS_Help_Thermal: Retained Heat: This pressure appears only when effective clothing insulation and sustained thermoregulation signals show meaningful retained heat. Short spikes stay hidden.
UI_AMS_Help_Breathing: Restricted Breathing: This pressure appears only while respirators, gas masks, or other sealed headgear are adding load during exertion.
UI_AMS_Help_Sleep: Sleep Restriction: This pressure appears only while worn rigid gear is actively reducing sleep recovery.
UI_AMS_Help_CostDrivers: Cost Drivers: Shows which worn items contribute most to your total burden, sorted by impact. If one item dominates the list, swapping it out will make the biggest difference.
UI_AMS_Help_ExportTitleDesc: Support Reports: If something feels wrong, use this to save a snapshot of your current loadout, burden calculations, mod list, and game state to a text file. Attach it when reporting a problem.
